tips._review: Draft translation — needs review by the partner physio before launch
tips.t0: Warm up for 2 to 3 minutes before you start, even for a short session.
tips.t1: Breathe normally while you exercise — never hold your breath.
tips.t2: Sharp pain means stop the exercise; mild, bearable discomfort is normal.
tips.t3: Do your sessions at a set time: they quickly become a habit rather than an effort of will.
tips.t4: Drink a glass of water before you start, especially when it's hot.
tips.t5: The quality of the movement matters more than speed — slow down if you need to.
tips.t6: A stable floor and some clear space are enough, no special equipment needed.
tips.t7: Note how you feel after the session: your physio takes it into account.
tips.t8: Consistency beats intensity — three short sessions are better than one long, rare one.
tips.t9: Stretch gently at the end of the session to finish on a pleasant note.
